title: Words Within Two Edits of Dictionary
sourceKind: search-snippets-only (official page returns 403 to WebFetch; statement taken from search-result summaries of secondary sites)
summary: Given queries and dictionary string arrays of equal-length lowercase words, return the queries (in original order) that match some dictionary word after at most two letter changes.
officialConstraints: Secondary sources describe at most 100 words of length up to 100 (not confirmed on the official page).
